scope: Explicit Vector finite gradual-underflow policy; no RTL, full-size run, physical resource, timing, throughput, or native whole-layer acceptance signoff.

checks.name: explicit_policy_and_legacy_default
checks.evidence: vector.py:19-21,58-62,127-129,173-176; legacy default mask 30, IEEE mask 28. Both retain invalid/div0/overflow as fatal plus finite-input/result checks.

checks.name: rounded_results_and_flags_unchanged
checks.evidence: vector16.cpp complete primitive/environment prefix is byte-identical to the M16 snapshot. RNE and FTZ/DAZ checks, per-lane flag generation, and caller sticky-flag restoration are unchanged.

checks.name: batch_selected_mask_and_old_abi
checks.evidence: vector16.cpp:72-92; new entry accepts only masks 30/28, gates Add using selected mask, old ABI forwards with mask 30.

checks.name: separate_mul_add_no_fma
checks.evidence: vector16.cpp:78,83 call unchanged compute separately; strict compiler flags preserve rounding. Direct FMA-discriminating case produced +0 in both policies.

checks.name: first_fault_not_swallowed
checks.evidence: model.py:_op/_mul_add remember and rethrow ArithmeticFault; _advance returns terminal Numerical. Batch retains last attempted stage and per-stage issue flags; IEEE accepted underflow does not become an artificial first fault.

checks.name: midjob_policy_identity
checks.evidence: model.py:568,579 latch/check policy string and fatal mask alongside resource identity before owner tick. Direct mutation of either field was rejected without advancing owner.ticks.

checks.name: per_job_flags
checks.evidence: model.py flag_baseline/flag_counts capture at admission and release; active report uses delta. Python increments full unmasked logical-issue flag values.

checks.name: independent_fixed_reference
checks.evidence: reference.py fixed_chunk validates its explicit policy; local node closure passes gradual-underflow choice through matmul and solve. It uses separate NumPy FP32 operations and imports no owner/Vector/scalar candidate. BF16 output and FP32 state unchanged.

checks.name: native_reference_unchanged_policy_semantics
checks.evidence: Final native_prepared_chunk has no exception_policy parameter; original conditional Torch suffix remains separately sourced and diagnostic.

checks.name: chisel_gap_disclosed
checks.evidence: ElementwiseMemoryEngine.scala:58 still treats exceptionFlags(4,1) as fatal. model.py source_identity explicitly marks IEEE control unbound and states routing/per-job control gap; no new hardware claim.

checks.name: exp_recipe_and_diagnostic_scope
checks.evidence: Owner scalar sources, BlockFloat, and retained arithmetic sources match M16 snapshot hashes. Original abs>=80 +0 saturation retained. exp_domain.json identifies only local primitive error and has null whole-output/state bound and no threshold assignment.

directed_review_probes.old_abi_vs_mask30: Identical: Mul underflow flags=3, stage=1, Add unissued.
directed_review_probes.mask28_underflow_then_add_overflow: stage=2, issue_flags=[3,5], final lane flags=[5,0]; selected mask permits only finite underflow progression.
directed_review_probes.midjob_mutations: Both exception_policy and fatal_mask rejected before owner tick.

test_evidence.parent_reported_reference_tests: 15 PASS; sole later change removed unused native signature parameter.
test_evidence.parent_combined_suite: Not independently repeated; parent owns final status/receipt.

resolved_findings.finding: Unused exception_policy parameter could imply native policy selection. Parent removed it; verified final AST while fixed_chunk retains explicit option.

limitations: The supplied M16 snapshot omits reference.py and test_ieee_policy.py; those files were reviewed directly, not represented as exact snapshot diffs.
model.py also contains independent transport-drain changes relative to M16. This review covers the policy delta, policy identity, flags, and fault propagation rather than full transport re-signoff.
No full-size M128 IEEE rerun or whole-layer official acceptance was performed by this reviewer.
No RTL, EDA, physical resource, timing, or throughput claims are established.
